description: This file defines a Presenter class for displaying Recipe objects as ImageCards in an Android TV application using Leanback library. It handles creating, binding, and unbinding views for recipe display.

classes.name: RecipeCardPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter subclass that displays Recipe objects within ImageCardViews, handling view creation, data binding, and cleanup.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes an ImageCardView for displaying a Recipe.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Recipe object to the ImageCardView, setting title, description, image, and dimensions.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the main image from the card view to free memory when unbinding.
